purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-hoshuu) billing system - inpatient admission master update subprogram used by screen K08
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that handles inpatient admission (nyuuin) master record updates. It processes medical treatment act data, insurance combination records, patient information, and calculates hospitalization fees including examination charges. It is called from screen K08 and manages creation, modification, and deletion of inpatient treatment records.

notable_features: 39 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA .INC copybooks
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA (Scratch Pad Area) pattern typical of JMA ORCA
OCCURS tables for treatment act data
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary DB access layer (MCPDATA.INC)
File path /var/tmp/ indicating Linux/Unix runtime environment
verdict.notes: Source file contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in the visible text. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system for Japanese clinics. File is 3662 lines, truncated at 16000 chars for analysis but structural indicators confirm full COBOL program. No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations - uses display numerics with implied decimal (V notation).
